comparison.objective: Safely extract low toast with wooden tongs and leave the toaster restored; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: The toaster task tests tool selection, lever holding, tong grasping, and hazard-zone avoidance rather than bimanual sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Toast on plate, prohibited intrusion/fork use avoided, lever and tongs restored, with a 1 s terminal hold; candidate grades recovery, retention, reseating, spill/damage history, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Safe tool-mediated extraction from an appliance tests a different ability from selective many-body separation.
